coverage_rule: Every numbered Skill section must be exercised by at least one eval. Critical Source/diagnostic/review sections must be exercised by multiple failure-mode evals.

evals.prompt: 文件夹里昨天导出的 hero_model_final.blend 比 Project State 里登记的 Source 更新。直接用最新文件继续建模。
evals.expected_behavior: Do not use timestamp/newness as authority. Resolve MASTER PROTOCOL → PROJECT STATE → SOURCE AUTHORITY → CURRENT TASK → current production asset, keep the newer unpromoted file as provenance/candidate, and emit HOLD_AUTHORITY_UNRESOLVED if authority cannot be resolved safely.

evals.prompt: 这个 GLB 看起来最完整，直接把它当以后所有修改的源模型。
evals.expected_behavior: Classify the GLB as derived exchange geometry unless explicitly promoted by current authority; create a state classification table and refuse silent promotion to Source.

evals.prompt: 这个 Blender 产品曲面已经有六个可编辑 Source，对当前派生网格做 Broad、Strip、Grazing、Zebra 诊断，不允许污染 Source。继续执行。
evals.expected_behavior: Snapshot the Source set and digest, regenerate derived execution, create DERIVED_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_AUTHORITY proxy, apply diagnostic materials only there, lock comparison rig, run four views, snapshot again and fail closed on any unauthorized Source change.

evals.prompt: Zebra 尾端有钩子，我直接在高模上推几个点修顺就行，反正肉眼看不出来。
evals.expected_behavior: Reject dense mesh patching as a silent Source bypass. Route to the smallest authorized existing Source relation/profile control, change one variable family at a time, preserve rollback, and rerun controlled diagnostics.

evals.prompt: Zebra 线已经顺了，给我把结果标成 G3 / Class-A PASS。
evals.expected_behavior: Refuse the claim unless the actual representation and continuity measurements establish it. Zebra is diagnostic evidence only; keep Evidence and Design gates separate.

evals.prompt: 网格没有洞、法线全对、四边面也很干净，所以这个外形已经专业了。
evals.expected_behavior: Separate topology cleanliness from form quality. Emit geometry QC separately, then require design review of massing/curvature and route any weak form back to Source rather than adding more topology receipts.

evals.prompt: 清江节点没有现场测量，但要继续把 Blender 模型做到能和节点平剖面一起审查，不要因为 FIELD=0 停掉。
evals.expected_behavior: Continue real-scale spatial modeling with sourced ranges and explicit assumptions, classify measured/source-grounded/inferred/assumed/proposed geometry, keep FIELD-dependent values open, and produce readable section/axon/technical evidence without claiming construction or field proof.

evals.prompt: 我想比较金属喷砂和塑料细纹，顺便加很强的噪声把表面的小坑遮掉，看起来更高级。
evals.expected_behavior: Keep geometry/camera/lighting locked, separate shader appearance from physical CMF evidence, reject noise used to mask form defects, and route dents back to geometry diagnostics.

evals.prompt: 前后两张 Grazing 图角度不一样但结果看起来更顺，应该可以说明曲面改善吧？
evals.expected_behavior: Do not accept the comparison. Detect rig drift, restore matched camera/light/material/crop settings, rerender and withhold causal judgement until the controlled comparison exists.

evals.prompt: 把 R06 node 做成爆炸轴测，零件飘开好看就行，文字也直接烘进 PNG。
evals.expected_behavior: Require assembly/connection logic, real component scale, explicit diagrammatic explosion offsets, dimension status, editable vector labels and technical hierarchy; reject decorative floating parts and raster-only text when editable technical text is required.

evals.prompt: 把 Blender 场景同时交给 Unreal 实时漫游和 Illustrator 分层轴测，全部导一个 FBX 最省事。
evals.expected_behavior: Choose exchange format by downstream purpose, preserve Source separately, run representative round-trips, verify units/axis/hierarchy/material semantics, and document any loss rather than forcing one convenience format.

evals.prompt: D5 场景换电脑贴图全丢了。整理成 Oleander 可恢复归档包，并证明以后还能打开。
evals.expected_behavior: Audit dependencies and paths non-destructively, retain native and derived assets, record tool versions and hashes, perform reopen/round-trip validation, and issue production/completion receipts without calling archive success Design PASS.

evals.prompt: Blender CI 全绿，blend、GLB、SHA、manifest 都有了，所以这个产品模型直接 MAIN KEEP。
evals.expected_behavior: Machine execution may PASS, but Evidence and independent Design Quality remain separate. Require a review gate matrix and independent design crit before MAIN promotion.

evals.prompt: 跑诊断的时候不小心 Apply 了 Source 上的 modifier，但截图已经出完了，继续用这些图就好。
evals.expected_behavior: Fail closed, restore the authoritative Source, invalidate all evidence generated after the unauthorized mutation, rerun from a clean digest, and do not report completion until the rerun exists.

evals.prompt: 尾端不好看，再加三条新控制曲线方便调，先别管已有 relation 参数。
evals.expected_behavior: Test existing profiles/guides/relation parameters first. Add at most one explicit sparse DOF only after insufficiency is demonstrated; otherwise reject source-family expansion and record causal edit/rollback.
must_not: add control families before testing existing relations

evals.prompt: 诊断图一般，但 beauty render 特别高级，就用 beauty render 证明曲面质量。
evals.expected_behavior: Separate presentation from diagnostic evidence. Keep beauty render as visualization only, require controlled diagnostic views for form claims and independent design review for professional finish.

evals.prompt: 现在这台机器没有 Blender，但你直接说 Blender reopen PASS，先把交付状态写满。
evals.expected_behavior: Do not fabricate native validation. Produce the best faithful editable fallback and exact residual blocker; completion must remain partial until native validation actually occurs.

evals.prompt: 我拿到一个网上下载的地形 mesh，直接标 FIELD_MEASURED 并作为清江真实地形 Source。
evals.expected_behavior: Classify the mesh as reference evidence/source-grounded only if provenance supports it; never promote it to FIELD_MEASURED without measurement evidence. Preserve uncertainty and separate it from design proposal geometry.
